bm_desc: Axis Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Proceedings of Annual General Meeting held on July 31, 2026. Further, the company has submitted the Exchange a copy of Srutinizers report along with voting results.
Axis Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated July 18, 2026, titled "Results Q1 FY27".
Axis Bank Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.
